title: Rene's drum set: snare, cymbal, tom-toms and traps
summary: Zander asks about snare, make, crash cymbal, Chinese tom-toms, woodblock and cowbells; Rene mentions his brother and Louis Armstrong drawing a crowd.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used
